# CONFIG_RELOAD

The annotations that make a workload restart when a Secret or ConfigMap it mounts changes.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `reload`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.reload`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
